verdict.rationale: Zapier documents built-in agents, created with help from its in-product Zapier Copilot, that perform tasks across 9,000+ apps using your business data. It also uses AI in-product to generate troubleshooting instructions. Zapier MCP, by contrast, serves external AI clients (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor), so it is not a built-in assistant and is not credited here. missing for 10: in-depth docs on how tasks are delegated to Zapier Agents/Copilot (scope, supervision, execution flow), independent or hands-on corroboration of the in-product assistant.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Create specialized agents—with the help of Zapier Copilot—to connect to your business data and perform tasks across 9,000+ apps.
Zapier will use AI to create troubleshooting instructions for you to review.
